dossier_meta.statement_text: Is there a constant $c>0$ such that every graph with minimum degree 3 contains a cycle of length $\ell$ with at least $c\ell$ chords?
dossier_meta.context_text: While high minimum degree guarantees cycles with many chords, the authors ask whether minimum degree 3 alone suffices to guarantee a cycle whose chord count is proportional to its length. The disjoint union of copies of $K_4$ shows one cannot simply require many chords without controlling cycle length, motivating the search for a linearly-chorded cycle.
